WITH delivered AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders_with_delivery_date,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date) AS delayed_orders
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
    AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  delivered_orders_with_delivery_date,
  delayed_orders,
  ROUND(
    CASE WHEN delivered_orders_with_delivery_date = 0 THEN 0
         ELSE (delayed_orders::numeric / delivered_orders_with_delivery_date::numeric) * 100
    END
  , 2) AS delay_rate_pct
FROM delivered;

WITH metrics AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
        AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
    ) AS delivered_orders_with_delivery_date,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
        AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
        AND order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date
    ) AS delayed_orders
  FROM orders
)
SELECT
  delivered_orders_with_delivery_date,
  delayed_orders,
  CASE
    WHEN delivered_orders_with_delivery_date = 0 THEN 0.00
    ELSE ROUND((delayed_orders::numeric / delivered_orders_with_delivery_date::numeric) * 100, 2)
  END AS delay_rate_pct
FROM metrics;
